1  SHEET DATED 02.07.2023, FIR BEARING NO.74/2022 DATED  29.05.2022 REGISTERED BY THE NYAMATHI P.S., ON THE FALSE  COMPLAINT FILED BY THE RESPONDENT NO.2 IN C.C.NO.385/2023  ON THE FILE OF THE ADDL.CIVIL JUDGE AND J.M.F.C HONNALI FOR  THE OFFENCE P/U/S 504,323,307,498A, 506,34 OF IPC AND SEC.3,4  OF D.P ACT AND ETC.,
 -2-  NC: 2024:KHC:19299  CRL.P No. 13909 of 2023  THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

This petition is filed for quashing the charge sheet dated 02.07.2023, FIR bearing No.74/2022 dated 29.05.2022 registered by the Nyamathi Police Station on the false complaint filed by Respondent No.2 in C.C. NO.385/2023 on the file of Addl. Civil Judge and JMFC., Honnali for the offences punishable under Sections 504, 323, 307, 498A, 506, 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
2. After arguing the matter for sometime, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission of the Court to withdraw the petition.
4. Criminal petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
5. In view of dismissal of criminal petition, I.A.1/2023 filed for stay does not survive for consideration.
